target.statement: EVOPROMPT (DE) achieves 94.75% accuracy on SST-2 with Alpaca-7b, compared to 93.68% for manual instructions.

compute.basis: Requires running Alpaca-7b inference on SST-2 dev/test sets for multiple evolutionary iterations (population size N, iterations T) and 3 random seeds, plus GPT-3.5 API calls for prompt generation; 7B model inference on CPU is very slow, making GPU necessary for reasonable runtime.

blockers: Requires OpenAI GPT-3.5 API access (closed-source, paid) for evolutionary operators
Requires running Alpaca-7b (7B parameters) for evaluation, which is slow on CPU and needs GPU for practical runtime
Code repository may not include exact configs for SST-2 reproduction
title: EvoPrompt: Connecting LLMs with Evolutionary Algorithms Yields Powerful Prompt Optimizers
